TICKS_PER_SECOND = 10_000
COUNTER_MODULUS = 1 << 16  # 16-bit counter wraps every 65536 ticks (6.5536 s)


def gate_time_s(start_tick, stop_tick):
    """Return the sprint time in seconds from two latched 16-bit tick counts.

    The counter runs at 10,000 ticks per second and wraps at 65536. Because
    a sprint lasts less than 6 seconds (shorter than the 6.5536 s wrap
    period), the counter can wrap at most once between the gates, so modular
    subtraction recovers the true elapsed tick count.
    """
    for name, value in (("start_tick", start_tick), ("stop_tick", stop_tick)):
        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
            raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an int, got {type(value).__name__}")
        if not 0 <= value < COUNTER_MODULUS:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be in 0..{COUNTER_MODULUS - 1}, got {value}")

    elapsed_ticks = (stop_tick - start_tick) % COUNTER_MODULUS
    return elapsed_ticks / TICKS_PER_SECOND
